steps.label: Conjugate: z* = a - bi
steps.sub: Flip the sign of the imaginary part only — reflects across the real axis

steps.label: z * z* = a^2 + b^2
steps.sub: The cross terms cancel and i^2 flips sign — no i left at all

steps.label: The result is always zero or positive

caption: Squaring the modulus and multiplying by the conjugate are two different-looking calculations that always produce the identical real number.

steps.label: A measurement probability will equal |amplitude|^2
steps.sub: Computed as amplitude* times amplitude — the Born rule, formalized later

steps.label: That product is guaranteed real and non-negative
steps.sub: Exactly the property a valid probability needs to have
